---

As a long time Dungeon Master, one thing I often face when introducing new players to Dungeons and Dragons is the overwhelming amount of rules involving magic. If you don't know, every spell has quite a few specifics to it and you cannot just declare that you throw fire at your enemies. There are dice involved, measurements, sometimes material, verbal or somatic components... it is a lot... but as a new player, you often really just want to throw fire at goblins or make plants grow real fast... 

So here is where my tool comes in: You describe in plain English what you want to do and it searches the rule book for you, finding the spells that best accomplish that. 

If you are interested about how this thing works on the inside, checkout my [blog post](../blog/using_semantic_search_for_dnd.qmd).
